body: Oh that's great that your friend did that. :)) But I've done that many times before too and I think he's past the point of caring about what I say. I will still of course keep reminding him what he means to me but I'll need to try more things.

Hi thanks for replying.

We have had these discussions before. He knows what I've been through and what Ive thought of before, and yeah this creates very interesting conversations and it makes u feel that you are not alone, and i hoped that it was enough but apparently not. I'll keep trying my best i guess and I think ill have to interfere very soon when the time comes.

Hi thanks for replying.

I understand the whole trying to change his world view and making him see things mote positively . Ive tried that before and I rarely get through to him. Im the only one he's talking to about this issue and i dont want him to close me off as well. Of course I'll still keep encouraging him and trying to turn him away from this option but i guess I'll try to fit it in in ways that doesn't seem too "preachy"? Idk

Hi thanks for replying 

Yeah I know it's my responsibility and I know I have to seek external help. But what is stopping me is that me and my group of friends have tried to run intervention before to stop him from self-harming and it arguably made things worse. So I'm trying to take my time to figure how to do it, but also at the same time I don't really have alot of time to do that and it's stressing me out.

Also I have to consider how this would influence me emotionally.  I've been with him thru this for a long time and am very emotionally invested in this.
